question: After imposing the leading regular finite-B/comoving condition, can the O(k^2) preferred Hamiltonian and momentum constraints be combined to give B0 directly in terms of the O(k^2) total comoving-source coefficient and leading metric/A-source quantities, with all psi_prime,2 dependence cancelling?

scope.limit: x->0 at fixed a>0, finite M_c>0
scope.regular_series: delta_mu=dm0+x dm2+..., Q=Q0+x Q2+..., psi=psi0+x psi2+..., psi_prime=psip0+x psip2+..., phi=phi0+x phi2+..., B=B0+...
scope.leading_condition: Q0=D(psip0+H phi0) and a^2 dm0+H Q0=0

acceptance: expand the preferred Hamiltonian constraint to O(x): -2 D H^2 phi2-r E_th phi0=-3a^2 r dm2-D H Q2+2D H psip2-2r Pcal psi0
solve this equation for phi2 and insert it into N2=Q2-D(psip2+H phi2)
prove exactly, using D=2+3r, that all psip2 dependence cancels and N2=-(r/(2H))[-E_th phi0+3H Q2+2Pcal psi0+3a^2 dm2]
combine with B0=-N2/r from C10.53 to obtain B0=[3a^2 dm2+3H Q2+2Pcal psi0-E_th phi0]/(2H)
with Q2=3a q2 define C2_pref=3a^2 dm2+9Ha q2 and rewrite B0=[C2_pref+2Pcal psi0-E_th phi0]/(2H)
prove the total comoving combination C=3a^2 delta_mu+9Ha q is exactly invariant under the already-certified Newtonian/preferred source time-shift when rho_prime=-3H W, so C2_pref=C2_N for regular B
using psi0=-(3/(2M_c^2)) deltaH0_pref,0, show the formula is identical to the C10.50 finite-phi small-k regularity limit
machine-check every symbolic residual as exactly zero and emit an immutable certificate
next_if_pass: The physical early-time calculation only needs the baseline-species O(k^2) coefficient C2 together with the leading ordinary A-source/psi0 and phi0 normalization; derive those from the completed-U1 adiabatic matter hierarchy and evaluate B0 without integrating chi independently.
non_claims: does not yet derive the baseline-species C2 coefficient
does not fix the primordial normalization phi0
does not include massive-neutrino anisotropic stress
does not implement completed-U1 CLASS feedback
